quest.title: To Wish Upon a Star
quest.description: You encounter a child looking for star shards out in the wild...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Orqo
dialogues.text: Dad'll be happy, for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Orqo
dialogues.text: Hey, what're you waiting for? Hurry up! We've gotta put the scattered fragments back on the star!
Wow! Amazing! You guys found all the star shards!
I've saved up quite a bit of pocket money from helping out Mama Coco. I'll give you every last Mora if you give the shards to me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Star shards? What are they for? Uh... And before that, what the heck is a little kid doing out here all alone?

dialogues.speaker: Orqo
dialogues.text: ...Everyone else calls me Orqo, so you might as well too. Though it's only a codename...

dialogues.speaker: Orqo
dialogues.text: I'm only here to collect the star shards! You guys saw the big rock down below too, right? That's a star, fallen from the sky!

dialogues.speaker: Orqo
dialogues.text: As long as we can collect the scattered shards and return them to it, we can gain the power that was lost... Please, I'm begging you, I really do need these star shards...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... But it still counts as a clue, right? Why don't we give it a try and see what happens?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, though, star shards and lost power and whatnot... That sounds like something out of a novel.

response.speaker: Orqo
response.text: You've never even heard the story of Qoyllor and Ukuku? My dad's told me it a million times, I've got it completely memorized. I'd be happy to share it with you!

response.speaker: Orqo
response.text: But let's go down there together first!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You and Orqo arrive beside the "fallen star"...

response.speaker: Orqo
response.text: C'mon, hurry up and put the fragments back on the star! Wow... I wonder what power will awaken? Maybe I'll even ascend to the sky... Hehe!

choices.text: Whoa, that amazing? Okay, I definitely can't give 'em to you now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, he's just a little kid! Ease up a bit. And even though we don't know if it's true or not, why don't we give it a try and see what happens?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, what are you doing here?
...Whoa! You scared me half to death! What if I fell? How would you pay me back? My hidden powers haven't been awakened yet, you know, I'm just a helpless little child.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! Sorry, Paimon didn't mean to give you a fright! But... hidden powers? Would you develop some super duper ultimate technique or something?
Look, it's called a "hidden" power for a reason. If it's hidden, how the heck would I know what it is?

response.text: Look, let's put all that to the side for now. Can you help me find the star shards? I've saved up quite a bit of pocket money from helping out Mama Coco, and you can have every last Mora.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, since you're asking us for help, could you at least tell us your name? By the way, Paimon's Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Orqo
response.text: The name I use now is nothing but a code name, that's all... But everyone calls me Orqo, so you might as well too. Now, about those star shards, will you help?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Though... Just what is a star shard? Doesn't sound like it's something you can come by too easily.

response.speaker: Orqo
response.text: They're shards split off from stars that fell from the sky! As long as you find them and return them to their original spot, you can regain the power that was lost.

response.speaker: Orqo
response.text: Look! A fallen star is just down below, so there's gotta be some leads to find star shards down there. C'mon, please gimme a hand!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, okay, we'll help you out this time! Still, though, star shards and lost power and whatnot... That feels like something out of a novel.

response.speaker: Orqo
response.text: You've never even heard the story of Qoyllor and Ukuku? My dad's told me it a million times, I've got it completely memorized. I'd be happy to share it with you!

response.speaker: Orqo
response.text: But let's go down and take a look together first!

choices.text: So young, yet so full of baloney.

dialogues.speaker: Orqo
dialogues.text: Phew! I'd never have made it by myself, thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So is this the fallen star? If you look at it up close...

choices.text: Aaaah! A mysterious power is surging through my body!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh!? Really? Hey, wait a sec, we haven't even found the scattered fragments yet!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of the fragments, are there really clues to them around here? Paimon doesn't see anything...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, what's next?

response.speaker: Orqo
response.text: We'll have to rely on our raw strength. <color=#00E1FFFF>Hit it with all the might of a Tepetlisaurus</color>, and maybe we'll find out where the missing fragments are.

response.speaker: Orqo
response.text: Brute force can solve most problems! That's what my dad says. But I still haven't awoken my strength, and I don't have my own Saurian either... So you're all I've got.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It definitely looks peculiar enough... But is Paimon just a bit slow? She doesn't feel any kind of mysterious power from it at all...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That should be all, right? This commission was way easier than Paimon thought it'd be! Still, do miraculous powers like that exist? Paimon was pretty skeptical before...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Want to awaken some hidden powers too, do you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Of course! Wouldn't it make things really easy if you had, say, a super treasure-seeking ability or the power to just destroy any monster with one punch? C'mon, {NICKNAME}, wouldn't you want that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh!

response.speaker: Orqo
response.text: C'mon, hurry up and put the fragments back on the star! Wow... I wonder what power will awaken? Maybe I'll even ascend to the sky... Hehe!

choices.text: I'm strong enough as-is. I don't need it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? But doesn't everyone say that the pursuit of more power is endless?

talks.objective: Wait for the hidden power to awaken...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, do you feel any unbelievable power?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not really, no.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The big rock hasn't changed a bit! No mysterious glow, not even sudden shaking or just cracking right open.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, did we use the wrong incantation? It sounded right to Paimon, though...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, we occasionally run into situations like this when we're exploring ruins! If you misremember the password or signal, the mechanism just won't respond.

dialogues.speaker: Orqo
dialogues.text: Weird... I was told saying that stuff would liberate the hidden power...

dialogues.speaker: Orqo
dialogues.text: And the person who told me closed their eyes and started moaning in pain soon after they recited it! Not only that, but afterward, he gained a "magic eye" that could tell the value of gems!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Sounds kinda dubious.
Oh my! I've finally found you, you silly little goose! How'd you end up out here? Your father's been worried sick about you!

response.speaker: Orqo
response.text: I told him I'd go back when it's time to eat! Did he have to tell you...

response.speaker: Mama Coco
response.text: Still talking back? You two kids down there, don't you tarry either! Who knows what kind of dangers might show up if you dally there!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You bring Orqo back up, and explain the situation...

response.speaker: Mama Coco
response.text: *sigh* Those are just childish fantasies he was talking about. Sorry you had to get involved in his mischief.

response.speaker: Mama Coco
response.text: He's gotten quite naughty, as nobody really disciplines him. After all, his mother isn't around and his father's eyesight is poor. I try to help out as a neighbor, but I haven't got unlimited energy either.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohh, so that's it! Paimon knew it! There's no way something like that could be true... Imagine just collecting a few stone fragments and getting mysterious powers...

response.speaker: Orqo
response.text: I'm not being naughty, it's for dad...

response.speaker: Mama Coco
response.text: Don't be so bird-brained! It's all because you won't listen to those older and wiser. At least you're safe and sound this time, but did you ever stop to think about what would happen if you got into some real trouble someday?

response.speaker: Mama Coco
response.text: Hmph! Enough. You just behave now and come back with me.

response.speaker: Orqo
response.text: Fine... But first... Here you go, you two. We did agree. Here's the Mora I promised.

response.speaker: Mama Coco
response.text: Do take it. We wouldn't want him to be someone who isn't true to their word.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, since you put it that way... We won't say no.

response.speaker: Orqo
response.text: Yeah, and maybe I'll need your help in the future! We failed this time, but that doesn't mean we won't succeed next time, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Huh?

response.speaker: Mama Coco
response.text: You little munchkin...

response.speaker: Orqo
response.text: C'mon, Mama Coco. Let's go, my dad's waiting! Thank you both, see you next time!
